hadith:
Sales and Trade - Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:

Hakim bin Hizam said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I used to do good deeds in the Pre-Islamic period of Ignorance, e.g., keeping good relations with my Kith and kin, manumitting slaves and giving alms. Shall I receive a reward for all that?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "You embraced Islam with all the good deeds which you did in the past."
message: Embrace every act of kindness and goodness as they hold value beyond measure. Your efforts towards maintaining family ties, freeing others from bondage, and charitable acts will be rewarded when you embrace faith. Remember, Allah is Al Baasit, the One who expands provisions and blessings; He sees and appreciates all sincere intentions and actions.
name:
Al Baasit - الْبَاسِطُ - The Reliever

The name Al Baasit originates from the Arabic root word 'b-s-t', which conveys the concept of spreading or expanding. In Islamic tradition, it reflects Allah’s role in providing for His creation and ensuring that resources, both spiritual and material, are sufficiently available. This name highlights the boundless nature of Allah's provision and mercy.
